declaration: HRESULT WINAPI PeerIdentityCreate( PCWSTR pwzClassifier, PCWSTR pwzFriendlyName, HCRYPTPROV hCryptProv, PWSTR* ppwzIdentity);

evidence.detail: declaration, requirements block, parameter list read mechanically from the page

parameters.description: Specifies the classifier to append to the published peer identity name. This string is a Unicode string, and can be NULL. This string can only be 150 characters long, including the NULL terminator.
parameters.name: pwzClassifier

parameters.description: Specifies the friendly name of the peer identity. This is a Unicode string, and can be NULL. String length is restricted to 256 characters including the NULL terminator. If pwzFriendlyName is NULL, the name of the identity is the friendly name. The friendly name is optional, and it does not have to be unique.
parameters.name: pwzFriendlyName

parameters.description: Handle to the cryptographic service provider (CSP) that contains an AT_KEYEXCHANGE key pair of at least 1024 bits in length. This key pair is used as the basis for a new peer identity. If hCryptProv is zero (0), a new key pair is generated for the peer identity. Note The Identity Manager API does not support a CSP that has user-protected keys. If a CSP that has user-protected keys is used, PeerIdentityCreate returns E_INVALIDARG.
parameters.name: hCryptProv

parameters.description: Receives a pointer to the name of a peer identity that is created. This name must be used in all subsequent calls to the peer-to-peer Identity Manager or to PNRP functions that operate on behalf of the peer identity. Returns NULL if the peer identity cannot be created.
parameters.name: ppwzIdentity
